notes.title: Avatars Update
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone - we have deployed a new patch for those who have Steam keys to access Samsara for testing purposes. If you wish to play the latest update, you may need to restart Steam for it to pick up the patch.[/p][p]We are happy to share that there are changes to address the feedback regarding the feel and pacing of combat, as well as to tackle some of the other user feedback we received during the Steam Next Fest in June.[/p][p][b]July 2025 - Avatars Update[/b][/p][list][*][p]Unleash unique ultimate powers for all six avatars, powerful abilities that empower you to survive in the deadly world of Kamadhatu.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]New boss at the end of Uttarakuru: battle Mara, "the tempter" and his aspects.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]New boss at the end of Act 2: face the judgement of Yama, "Lord of Death" in your quest to escape Samsara.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Find a mischievous lost Tiryag in an optional questline found in Uttarakuru: End of an Age, who ponders the significance of the bell which tolls doom.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Changes to Combat pacing, animations and feel.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Additional bug fixes and improvements after player feedback.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for your continued feedback and bug reports. This update addresses several underlying issues, and we are hard at work on polishing content and fixing said issues. Our team is committed to improving your journey through the Bardo.[/p][p]We believe in transparency, and we want to continue to engage with our players as and when bugs appear. We appreciate your patience as we work to resolve these bugs. Please continue to report any issues you encounter via the in-game link in the Pause menu.[/p][p][/p][p]See you in the Bardo,[/p][p]☸️  Samsara Team[/p]

notes.title: June 9th Steam Next Fest Demo
notes.content:
[h1]Steam Next Fest Demo[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40958738/0723b3e46e9cede112e6c8a10fc37b1f95417586.png[/img]

The Free Demo of Samsara is ready to go!
The game releases in full [b]17th June 2025[/b]
[h2]What's included?[/h2]
We will be providing a demo of Samsara which includes the following:

[list]
[*] Opening tutorial area, the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwiki.infinity27.com%2Fapp%2Fpage%2F1fggl7cuQpshtWoJP_ldqQzkUdDBOM8TbDhROoYP5qZg%3Fp%3D1AzOOgioG8y4MVX1XC56Y47AEIk_cH5Ij]Rebirth Cave[/url] at the world's edge ("[url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwiki.infinity27.com%2Fapp%2Fpage%2F10bZxu4NLIE8-JVCoL17RbnhTFmDQKaeSpwbU2hZSS1I%3Fp%3D1AzOOgioG8y4MVX1XC56Y47AEIk_cH5Ij]Cakravada[/url]").
[*] A full level to explore within the Desire Realm ("[url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwiki.infinity27.com%2Fapp%2Fpage%2F1O8-godtQWFXUcKdvWCDwqYLZNjbBkyNm%3Fp%3D1AzOOgioG8y4MVX1XC56Y47AEIk_cH5Ij]Khamadhatu[/url]"), [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwiki.infinity27.com%2Fapp%2Fpage%2F1Z9sAg1buQ8On9cx_BY_pftI5VNVbOKWHQz8fTJgV80I%3Fp%3D1AzOOgioG8y4MVX1XC56Y47AEIk_cH5Ij]Jambudvipa[/url], a tropical continent located south of Mt Meru.
[*] Face off against the "Asura Lord of Jambudvipa": [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwiki.infinity27.com%2Fapp%2Fpage%2F1LksZ8ytDRzqV5H9QWt86pK3aOR955NMBdXvgGXYBmm4%3Fp%3D1AzOOgioG8y4MVX1XC56Y47AEIk_cH5Ij]Lord Matsala[/url], in a multi-phase boss fight that challenges everything you've learnt.
[*] Engage in an optional questline that impacts the game world: featuring the hedonistic and self-righteous Deva, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwiki.infinity27.com%2Fapp%2Fpage%2F1kep97qr2djHN7G_E6ZBeznVrJhw85n79em8eiXhDdO0%3Fp%3D1AzOOgioG8y4MVX1XC56Y47AEIk_cH5Ij]Suvana[/url].
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwiki.infinity27.com%2Fapp%2Fpage%2F1Ilm51RbW5BRkh4teT1VDB5g5HUVUyfnynNy2n_hf_9w%3Fp%3D1AzOOgioG8y4MVX1XC56Y47AEIk_cH5Ij]Reincarnate[/url] as 6 different playable [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwiki.infinity27.com%2Fapp%2Fpage%2F1X65ZDtBORTWHJdR7eFNAeeUhYBsRSylN%3Fp%3D1AzOOgioG8y4MVX1XC56Y47AEIk_cH5Ij]Avatars[/url]:
[list][*][p][b]Manusya [/b]- Smaller and weaker, but balanced - the only avatar capable of escaping.[/p][list][*][p][i]Playstyle[/i]: Jack of all trades, master of none.[/p][/*][*][p][i]Abilities[/i]: Protective gestures to shield, immobilise and contain enemies.[/p][/*][*][p][i]Lore[/i]: Symbolic of hope and closest to karmic harmony.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Deva [/b]- Those who distinguish themselves with acts of mercy and kindness are reborn as the Deva, who glide lightly through the air and boast a deep well of magical power.[/p][list][*][p][i]Playstyle[/i]: Weaver of magic, with healing and destruction hand in hand.[/p][/*][*][p][i]Abilities[/i]: Capable of creating illusions, healing and causing damage with the air element.[/p][/*][*][p][i]Lore[/i]: Pristine, deific beings residing in the heavens atop Mt Meru.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Asura [/b]- Righteous fury incarnate, the multi-armed Asura grows more powerful as their being diminishes.[/p][list][*][p][i]Playstyle[/i]: Fury personified, overwhelming enemies with their physical strength and elemental magic.[/p][/*][*][p][i]Abilities[/i]: Able to summon all five elements to cause damage, buff themselves with invulnerability and debuff enemies' defences.[/p][/*][*][p][i]Lore[/i]: Wrathful demi-gods known for their fiery tempers and prowess in battle.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Naraka [/b]- Hellish beings wielding fearsome and potent combat abilities that allow them to obliterate foes even at a distance.[/p][list][*][p][i]Playstyle[/i]: The Trickster, armed with dangerous magic that manipulates the battlefield.[/p][/*][*][p][i]Abilities[/i]: Wields fire at a distance to engulf, debuff and ensnare, while summoning more of its kind to overwhelm enemies.[/p][/*][*][p][i]Lore[/i]: Those who walk a path of violence or ill-will are attuned to and revel in punishment and suffering.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Tiryag [/b]- Animalistic with keen instincts that help them sense unseen foes and augment their focus in the heat of battle.[/p][list][*][p][i]Playstyle[/i]: A Hunter with the power to hone their senses to spot danger and become deadlier in combat.[/p][/*][*][p][i]Abilities[/i]: Able to astral travel, call on nature, sense enemies through their surroundings and slow time in combat.[/p][/*][*][p][i]Lore[/i]: Bestial warriors, fueled by their instincts.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Preta [/b]- Their greed requires them to sustain their life at the expense of others but leads them to treasures most would miss.[/p][list][*][p][i]Playstyle[/i]: Avarice manifest, feeding off of enemies and sharing their torment through afflictions.[/p][/*][*][p][i]Abilities[/i]: Senses hidden treasures, leeches health, debuffs and damages enemies over time.[/p][/*][*][p][i]Lore[/i]: The sorry fate of these beings is to know hunger unending, even in places of abundance.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[*] Various enemies, weapons, spells, accessories and offhand implements to find throughout your journey.
[/list]
[h2]Where to provide feedback?[/h2]
We have a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1683570/discussions/0/597398871354670140/]Steam Community Discussion[/url] which includes a number of ways to get in touch.

[h2]When will the demo be removed?[/h2]
The demo will be available for the duration of Steam Next Fest and for 2 weeks after, the final date it will be available is [b]2025-06-30[/b].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1683570/Samsara/
Consider adding us to your Wishlist as the full version of the game will arrive [b]2025-06-17[/b]
Samsara is available for Early Access purchase NOW on [url=www.samsaragame.com] SamsaraGame.com [/url].

notes.title: The World Cycle Update - Now Live!
notes.content:
[b]The World Progression Update is now LIVE[/b]

In this update, players will be able to complete the game and experience the full cycle of Samsara.

[list]
[*] Play through the entire Bardo ("intermediate state") after the moment of death: explore acts 1, 2 and 3 of the game in your quest to Escape Samsara - the endless cycle of death and rebirth into which all life is bound.
[*] Explore all four continents of Kamadhatu during Act 1, in pursuit of The Three Jewels. Find yourself thrust into the Heavens and Hells, in an expanded rebirth area, which harbours secret areas only accessible in Act 2. Find a way to Escape Samsara before Act 3, when the 49-day cycle obliterates Kamadhatu and the karmic winds of rebirth drag you into the next life.
[*] New challenge at the end of Aparagodaniya: in pursuit of the enigmatic Kamadhenu, a "wish-granting cow".
[*] Choose to help a mysterious old woman in an optional questline found in Aparagodaniya: A Voice in the Wind, to unravel the secret behind the endless war raging over the wish-granting cow.
[*] Track down a mysterious liquid, a source of powerful visions for the Preta outcast, Raksa: in Resplendent Visions, a new questline in Viratdeha.
[*] Additional bug fixes and improvements after player feedback.
[/list]
[b]Please note[/b]: Save game data will not be compatible with the new version. You will need to enter the settings menu and select to delete save data, else you'll fall through the floor endlessly. 

Gain access to the Early Access version at [url=www.samsaragame.com] samsaragame.com [/url]
Or add to your Wishlist to get the full version once it goes live June 17th!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1683570/Samsara/

notes.title: The World Cycle Update
notes.content:
[b]The World Progression Update[/b]

In this update, players will be able to complete the game and experience the full cycle of Samsara.

[list]
[*] Travel through all four continents and make your way to the summit of Mt Meru, or descend below and prove your skills.
[*] Experience the third boss encounter at the end of Apragodaniya where you will meet the enigmatic [i]Kamadhenu[/i], the [i]"wish-granting cow"[/i].
[*] Find new quests involving the above as well as [i]Raksa[/i] the strangely eloquent Preta.
[/list]

As always we will be running a supervised playtest, if you would like to get involved, please confirm your interest by joining our [url=https://discord.gg/bhJdAQGyAx]Discord[/url] and requesting the [i]Avatar Playtester[/i] role.
This will provide access to the Playtester Guidance posts as they go live before the session.

Playtest is scheduled for [b]10-APR-2025 2-8PM BST[/b]
Let us know your availability and we will pair you up with a developer for live feedback.

notes.title: Samsara Update Roadmap
notes.content:
[h2]What is included in the Samsara early access?[/h2]
[b]December 2024[/b] - Early Access release exclusive to the [i]Epic Game Store[/i]

[list]
[*] Three continents to explore within the Desire Realm ("[url=https://wiki.infinity27.com/app/page/1O8-godtQWFXUcKdvWCDwqYLZNjbBkyNm?p=1AzOOgioG8y4MVX1XC56Y47AEIk_cH5Ij]Khamadhatu[/url]"):

[olist]
[*][url=https://wiki.infinity27.com/app/page/1Z9sAg1buQ8On9cx_BY_pftI5VNVbOKWHQz8fTJgV80I?p=1AzOOgioG8y4MVX1XC56Y47AEIk_cH5Ij]Jambudvipa[/url], a tropical continent located south of Mt Meru;
[*][url=https://wiki.infinity27.com/app/page/1P69oS7hky9BoWQiupuSvkv8tO0cscVxK_4flBrR396A?p=1AzOOgioG8y4MVX1XC56Y47AEIk_cH5Ij]Viratdeha[/url], a jewel-encrusted and snow-bound continent to the east;
[*][url=https://wiki.infinity27.com/app/page/1bXnz74mjIZx61fye_Ot8kmfOjPa4IsN--84UbFhgLbM?p=1AzOOgioG8y4MVX1XC56Y47AEIk_cH5Ij]Aparagodaniya[/url], a once lush land that has turned to desert, in the west.
[/olist]
[*] Opening tutorial area, the [url=https://wiki.infinity27.com/app/page/1fggl7cuQpshtWoJP_ldqQzkUdDBOM8TbDhROoYP5qZg?p=1AzOOgioG8y4MVX1XC56Y47AEIk_cH5Ij]Rebirth Cave[/url] at the world's edge ("[url=https://wiki.infinity27.com/app/page/10bZxu4NLIE8-JVCoL17RbnhTFmDQKaeSpwbU2hZSS1I?p=1AzOOgioG8y4MVX1XC56Y47AEIk_cH5Ij]Cakravada[/url]").
[*] Face off against the "Asura Lord of Jambudvipa": [url=https://wiki.infinity27.com/app/page/1LksZ8ytDRzqV5H9QWt86pK3aOR955NMBdXvgGXYBmm4?p=1AzOOgioG8y4MVX1XC56Y47AEIk_cH5Ij]Lord Matsala[/url], in a multi-phase boss fight that challenges everything you've learnt.
[*] Engage an optional questline in Jambudvipa that impacts the game world: [url=https://wiki.infinity27.com/app/page/1ACrDd0WRAVXy9L488bSeN1_OVL9Gg7-C5Jkmassn3i4?p=1AzOOgioG8y4MVX1XC56Y47AEIk_cH5Ij]Matsala's Folly[/url], featuring the hedonistic and self-righteous Deva, [url=https://wiki.infinity27.com/app/page/1kep97qr2djHN7G_E6ZBeznVrJhw85n79em8eiXhDdO0?p=1AzOOgioG8y4MVX1XC56Y47AEIk_cH5Ij]Suvana[/url].
[*] [url=https://wiki.infinity27.com/app/page/1Ilm51RbW5BRkh4teT1VDB5g5HUVUyfnynNy2n_hf_9w?p=1AzOOgioG8y4MVX1XC56Y47AEIk_cH5Ij]Reincarnate[/url] as 6 different playable [url=https://wiki.infinity27.com/app/page/1X65ZDtBORTWHJdR7eFNAeeUhYBsRSylN?p=1AzOOgioG8y4MVX1XC56Y47AEIk_cH5Ij]Avatars[/url]:

[olist]
[*][url=https://youneedawiki.com/app/page/13nXOtpvoyk7hZKDQCeP0yVyLSgJgpzlvIDj8LoCpAKg?p=1AzOOgioG8y4MVX1XC56Y47AEIk_cH5Ij]Asura[/url] - [i]Anger [/i]- Wrathful demi-gods known for their fiery tempers and prowess in battle. Imposing and impassioned. Righteous fury incarnate, the multi-armed Asura grows more powerful as their being diminishes.
[*][url=https://youneedawiki.com/app/page/1fF3-a319LiBIyu8oJzhc-YVYxBIf1VwHaFuUv9Dn7og?p=1AzOOgioG8y4MVX1XC56Y47AEIk_cH5Ij]Deva[/url] - [i]Rapture [/i]- Pristine, deific beings residing in the heavens atop Mt Meru. Those who distinguish themselves with acts of mercy and kindness are reborn as the Deva, who glide lightly through the air and boast a deep well of magical power.
[*][url=https://youneedawiki.com/app/page/177k8XAxUa0EuoyhczVUsdtnOEDFPv6OcDvWy18-HsI0?p=1AzOOgioG8y4MVX1XC56Y47AEIk_cH5Ij]Tiryag[/url] - [i]Animality [/i]- Bestial warriors, fuelled by their instincts. Using their finely honed animal instincts for survival helps them sense unseen foes. Their heightened senses slow their perception of time in conflict, at the cost of being blinded by their single-minded mental state of stupidity and prejudice.
[*][url=https://youneedawiki.com/app/page/12Nq-YJpPDh-HSPsq99X-a2cCWm-l73zgzzsAjTmiC_Y?p=1AzOOgioG8y4MVX1XC56Y47AEIk_cH5Ij]Preta[/url] - [i]Hunger [/i]- A hungry ghost. Avarice manifest. A sorry fate. Forever hungry, even in places of abundance. Their being is gradually drained as their hunger is never truly sated. Their greed requires them to sustain their life at the expense of others, and they find treasures most would miss.
[*][url=https://youneedawiki.com/app/page/1iBYs85hRn9bqEtdrb0o2eHgMIg37AgR5z_MVLkjZEk8?p=1AzOOgioG8y4MVX1XC56Y47AEIk_cH5Ij]Manusya[/url] - [i]Desire, doubt, passion, pride and above all hope[/i] - Symbolic of hope and closest to karmic harmony. To be a human is to stand at the hub of fate’s wheel. Those whose karma has not yet pulled them far from where they began will take on this balanced form.
[*][url=https://youneedawiki.com/app/page/1EGVkpjBKNeonukdpIL-ZUs7018g4NwRCOfWl89qQxA0?p=1AzOOgioG8y4MVX1XC56Y47AEIk_cH5Ij]Naraka[/url] - [i]Hell [/i]- Vindictive, devious punishers. Those who walk a path of violence or ill-will are attuned to and revel in punishment and suffering. Hellish beings wielding fearsome and potent combat abilities that allow them to obliterate foes even at a distance.
[/olist]
[*]Various enemies, weapons, spells, accessories and offhand implements to find throughout your journey.
[/list]

[h2]What is the roadmap for Samsara updates?[/h2]
[b]February 2025[/b] - Uttarakuru Update
[list]
[*]Fourth continent: [url=https://wiki.infinity27.com/app/page/1NYiCSVg4c8qt2Bikej5GEO5_rFsgK3RSLi_BTcSW0TE?p=1AzOOgioG8y4MVX1XC56Y47AEIk_cH5Ij]Uttarakuru[/url], in the North of [url=https://wiki.infinity27.com/app/page/1O8-godtQWFXUcKdvWCDwqYLZNjbBkyNm?p=1AzOOgioG8y4MVX1XC56Y47AEIk_cH5Ij]Khamadhatu[/url].
[*]New boss at the end of Viratdeha: [url=https://wiki.infinity27.com/app/page/1Xn0GAQoqFjuZn14IQcqNTUIxm36xNT4_es0WvQYUcyg?p=1AzOOgioG8y4MVX1XC56Y47AEIk_cH5Ij]Khyati[/url], the fallen but proud Deva.
[*]Revamped [url=https://wiki.infinity27.com/app/page/1HrdqzTMaf7n1XRXkImoxOOjPOVcfSNifLLFUw-WapR0?p=1AzOOgioG8y4MVX1XC56Y47AEIk_cH5Ij]Meditation Menu[/url].
[*]Improvements to the [url=https://wiki.infinity27.com/app/page/1F-VbiANibP9w6Hpn4QHm_MgzGL_agrUA?p=1AzOOgioG8y4MVX1XC56Y47AEIk_cH5Ij]Exploration[/url] systems.
[*]New enemies, weapons, spells, accessories and offhand implements.
[/list]

[b]April 2025[/b] - World Progression Update
[list]
[*]New boss at the end of Aparagodaniya: fought in pursuit of the enigmatic [url=https://wiki.infinity27.com/app/page/1Sf_hcsKhKxrRfPww8YCW6Nob3rdldiFGYMlJZCRjRfE?p=1AzOOgioG8y4MVX1XC56Y47AEIk_cH5Ij]Kamadhenu[/url], a [i]"wish-granting cow"[/i].
[*]Improvements to the [url=https://wiki.infinity27.com/app/page/1t4evU-Ukz2brmbjxPbM4rl4vJMjl18SQ?p=1AzOOgioG8y4MVX1XC56Y47AEIk_cH5Ij]Combat[/url] systems.
[*]Additional content TBC.
[/list]

[b]June 2025[/b] - Samsara: Rebirth Release
[list]
[*]1.0 release on Steam and Epic Games Store.
[*]Face the "Lord of Death": [url=https://wiki.infinity27.com/app/page/1aSdTk-jrsi5IsLOs4RutKgo2Z3mkF2lKNYVBbyroBWY?p=1AzOOgioG8y4MVX1XC56Y47AEIk_cH5Ij]Yama[/url], the embodiment of impermanence and judge of ones past life and actions.
[*]Experience additional questlines and complete the story ("Escape Samsara") in the final update to the base game.
[*]Improvements to the [url=https://wiki.infinity27.com/app/page/1E_ak4fn4TYOIDcBD2ZfAwxnVASemHCOm?p=1AzOOgioG8y4MVX1XC56Y47AEIk_cH5Ij]Discourse[/url] systems.
[*]PROTOGÉ Mode added: see contributions from aspiring game developers who trained at INFINITY27, an Unreal Authorised Training Center.
[/list]

[h2]Are there any post-release updates planned?[/h2]
Yes. We have plans to continue to support the game with content updates but we wish to share them closer to the 1.0 release date. Games take time and we don't wish to overpromise at this stage.

notes.title: Uttarakuru Update
notes.content:
The Uttarakuru Release is available to all Playtester Avatars from [b]2PM to 8PM on 13TH FEB.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40958738/1ecfb6ea29898be5a38eaef7b412b55d2d1db9f1.png[/img]

If you don't already have access, say hello on our [url=https://discord.gg/46zKM43EM8]Discord[/url] and request the Playtester Role so we can get you started on a supervised test.
During the test you will be providing live commentary and feedback to our developers.

This is the first update since we hit Early Access, and it will be the first major update before it goes live for Steam Next Fest. 
We would love your help in getting feedback before this goes live, so join us and let us know what you think before it goes out for customers.

[b]Key Updates:[/b]
[b][url=https://wiki.infinity27.com/app/page/1Xn0GAQoqFjuZn14IQcqNTUIxm36xNT4_es0WvQYUcyg?p=1AzOOgioG8y4MVX1XC56Y47AEIk_cH5Ij]Viratdeha Boss Fight[/url][/b]:
Those that are able to brave to snow and gales while ascending the mountain of Viratdeha will discover a resplendent temple where [url=https://wiki.infinity27.com/app/page/1Xn0GAQoqFjuZn14IQcqNTUIxm36xNT4_es0WvQYUcyg?p=1AzOOgioG8y4MVX1XC56Y47AEIk_cH5Ij]Khyati[/url] waits, with friends.

[b][url=https://wiki.infinity27.com/app/page/1NYiCSVg4c8qt2Bikej5GEO5_rFsgK3RSLi_BTcSW0TE?p=1AzOOgioG8y4MVX1XC56Y47AEIk_cH5Ij]Uttarakuru[/url][/b]: 
The final main area on the player's journey, Uttarakuru will test even the most experienced players physically and mentally. Can you accept your fate?

[b][url=https://wiki.infinity27.com/app/page/1HrdqzTMaf7n1XRXkImoxOOjPOVcfSNifLLFUw-WapR0?p=1AzOOgioG8y4MVX1XC56Y47AEIk_cH5Ij]Meditation [/url]Revamp[/b]:
The inventory has been updated to improve usability, check and swap your equipment, see video previews of your spells, and delve into lore with item descriptions.

As always if you wish to become a playtester, join our Discord and speak up in the chat if you'd like to participate!
